name: @rovenue/landing
//cookie: cookie is not imported by this site. Astro 7 prerenders through dist/.prerender, which resolves "cookie" at runtime from the output directory upward; .npmrc sets node-linker=hoisted for Expo, so the workspace root holds cookie@0.7.2 (CommonJS) and the build dies on the missing named export parseCookie. Declaring it here puts cookie@2 in apps/landing/node_modules, which wins first. Remove it and `astro build` breaks.
